fixer.title: agentHost: use origin/main as the default branch when origin/HEAD still points at an older origin/master

cases.mechanism: Trusting a stale but existing origin/HEAD target selected an obsolete branch-diff base. Every unrelated changed path since that old commit became a file entry, which the Changes editor eagerly loaded before its complete document set could render.
cases.symptom: Opening Branch Changes in an affected clone loaded potentially hundreds of unrelated files, including binaries, increasing file/model allocation and delaying editor document resolution. This consequence is established by the baseline-to-entry-to-eager-loading call path; no timing measurement is asserted.
cases.fixedBehavior: For a session without a saved base, a stale ancestor origin/master is replaced by origin/main before branch-diff baseline selection. Historical main-only file changes no longer enter the diff list, reducing downstream parsing, protocol payloads and eager text-model/file loading to the actual session changes. Saved bases and diverged refs remain unchanged.
cases.evidence: The replaced base-revision symbolic-ref probe at line 1440 supplied origin/HEAD directly to the Git-state fallback base. The new call at line 1470 and helper at 103-126 substitute origin/main when retained origin/master is its ancestor. Added integration test lines 832-856 establishes stale/diverged/dangling outcomes. AgentHostChangesetService._getBranchBaseBranch (2671-2685) uses Git-state base when none is saved; _computeBranchDiffs (1439-1440) passes it into computeSessionFileDiffs, which resolves merge-base HEAD/base and runs git diff (844-868). parseGitDiffRawNumstat (2150-2250) creates an entry for every changed path, including binary paths. _publishChangesetDiffs (2498-2519) publishes all entries. ChangesMultiDiffSourceResolver (68-75) maps each entry to a MultiDiffEditorItem, and MultiDiffEditorInput (236-246,317) eagerly resolves every side and awaits all document promises. Thus files introduced between the obsolete master tip and main caused real extra model/file loading, not merely an incorrect label.
